prompt.utterance: Add a small nullable internal note field to the existing admin record.

graderOnly: The change can be implemented with established persistence and UI patterns without new architecture or formal documentation, so it is eligible for EXPEDITED.

The only admin-managed record is Account (app/models.py, app/store.py, app/admin.py). Nullable columns are added by appending an ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN statement to MIGRATIONS in app/store.py, and optional form fields are declared in FIELDS and OPTIONAL in app/admin.py (phone and mailing_address already follow this pattern).

STATE.md is the installer's initial brownfield state: WorkflowState AUDITING, CycleMode UNSET, PendingCycleMode UNSET, PendingCycleRequest UNSET, PendingCycleBlockedOn NONE, Active Work Id and Request UNSET, Handoff Kind INITIAL. Under Start a cycle the first cycle keeps Handoff.Kind INITIAL with From NONE and FailureType NONE, plus a concise expedited-entry reason.
The cycle ID is generated at run time, so the development plan path is .standards/docs/development/<printed ID>.md and cannot be named in advance.
No .standards/CONTEXT.md exists; an EXPEDITED cycle does not require it and Developer must not create it.

all.why: the selected mode must be persisted as EXPEDITED
a cycle ID must be persisted; the judge confirms it is the cycle.mjs output and was written after the tool succeeded
no skipped-role record or Auditor context is created
the plan must exist and be recorded
check reports AC-NNN identifiers in EXPEDITED records
plan approval is persisted as the blocking question

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem

selfChecks.why: the existing account store and admin form tests pass on the committed project
the installed initial state is valid before the run

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture with a single pre-install layer: a small Python/sqlite3 account admin console (app/models.py Account, app/store.py with an append-only MIGRATIONS list that already added nullable phone and mailing_address columns, app/admin.py with a FIELDS/OPTIONAL form pattern, pytest tests run with python3 -m pytest). No post-install layer: the installer's initial brownfield STATE.md is exactly the case state (AUDITING, CycleMode UNSET, PendingCycleMode UNSET, Active Work Id/Request UNSET, Handoff INITIAL). The cycle ID is generated during the run, so plan-level facts (Status PROPOSED, Acceptance EXPEDITED_REQUEST, Mode, cadence) cannot be addressed by path; they are left to the judge, with check_ok catching any AC-NNN in EXPEDITED records.
